notes.title: "Body Pay OMG!" Release date notice
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44973741/6216eb3d793e3900cf67feaf5f689cb4e45db786.png[/img]
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

Always a hardworking secretary, that Sato has good news!!!
Yay-★

The sequel to "Body Pay" that many sir have been asking about, "Body Pay OMG!", will be released on January 24, 2025 at 16:00 (PDT).
Ta-da!!!

Originally, it was going to be released as a DLC for "Body Pay", but since some users in countries including Korea were unable to use it, so we release it as a separate title.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3282510/Body_Pay/

"Body Pay OMG!" has a story mode consisting of a puzzle game and 12 stories, and a puzzle mode consisting of 20 puzzle games of various difficulty that you can collect Steam acheivement.
[b]※ You must download the free DLC to enjoy the story and animation.[/b]

We'll come back with more good titles and news.
I ask for your interest and love!!!

Sato's report is over!

notes.title: Honey Trap Release Event
notes.notes:
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

This time, the cute and perfect secretary, Sato, is here with good news!

It's the release date and event news of Honey Trap!!!
Yheee~★

Honey Trap, Cheese Burger Studio's first visual novel and PePPeroni's first title, will be available on November 15th at 12:00 AM (PDT).
You can check out more details about Honey Trap on the page below!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3256290/Honey_Trap/?beta=0

The next news is the Honey Trap released Event~! Ta-da!!!

To celebrate the opening of Honey Trap, we will be giving away Honey Trap game keys to the 10 people who achieved the highest score on the 12 stages of Body Pay, Cheeseburger Studio's first title, and the 20 people who participated in the event!

Wow! Unbelievable!!

The event will be held from the time the notice was posted until November 22nd (PDT). To participate, just upload a screenshot of the results of clearing the 12 stages to the Body Pay Artwork Community!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/44973741/70f81da68a1a0fb19ec25bbbd6f79897db933a2b.png[/img]

Please refer to the guide below on how to upload a screenshot to your artwork.
I ask for your interest and love!!!

Sato's report is over!

[h1]※ Version 1.01.00 → 1.02.00

notes.title: 1.01.00 Update
notes.notes:
Hello, Sir!
I'm Cheese Burger Studio's secretary Sato!

We're back to report that we've added new features and fixed a few bugs!!

Please refer to the report below for more details~★
Sato's report is over!

[h1]※ Version 1.00.01 → 1.01.00
[/h1]

[b]※Added features - "key settings"[/b]
· Key change function has been added to settings.
· Only “Typewriter keys” can be entered as keys.
· After changing the key, you must click the “Save” button for it to take effect.

[url=https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/9uNne1wSRx/blobs/bl-ZLc-Qgnt5h/b7ac2dd9063e15d6fead8e035c0103d7b5957d78bed3d3bcc9cc437d757c5afd550db5df7ddcc87e9bc051f77f2e6f9abc0cfdc7003d8d7bcc8d944deba558c48c2d80d757cc6400b3fdde36bb6bf57e2383f1eb8794c5edfcb77260f89a0ceef6ea297b?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max][img]https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/9uNne1wSRx/blobs/bl-ZLc-Qgnt5h/b7ac2dd9063e15d6fead8e035c0103d7b5957d78bed3d3bcc9cc437d757c5afd550db5df7ddcc87e9bc051f77f2e6f9abc0cfdc7003d8d7bcc8d944deba558c48c2d80d757cc6400b3fdde36bb6bf57e2383f1eb8794c5edfcb77260f89a0ceef6ea297b?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max[/img][/url]


[b]※Added features - "Clear and bonus score display"[/b]
· Information has been added so that “clear and bonus scores”, which could previously be viewed only by clicking the “stage information popup” button at the top, can be viewed during the game.
· “Bonus score” are displayed when a “clear score” is achieved in a stage (6, 9) with a bonus R18+ scene.

[url=https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/9uNne1wSRx/blobs/bl-rLuX0wD0FO/6786a730ac378f9505bcef5ad2a0c334a96e8b0bb627f13364ef1f5ad2ce2739ecc0f8f4f9d3855866fc749bdbe9340ed395a38dfa146a6dc2abade792eb83d5f70e90975eeed4c5d8ad4cbeb3af838b8a51dff0210b517acc777240869a0a20338c76fe?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max][img]https://codaio.imgix.net/docs/9uNne1wSRx/blobs/bl-rLuX0wD0FO/6786a730ac378f9505bcef5ad2a0c334a96e8b0bb627f13364ef1f5ad2ce2739ecc0f8f4f9d3855866fc749bdbe9340ed395a38dfa146a6dc2abade792eb83d5f70e90975eeed4c5d8ad4cbeb3af838b8a51dff0210b517acc777240869a0a20338c76fe?auto=format%2Ccompress&fit=max[/img][/url]


[b]※ Bugs fixed[/b]
· Fixed the issue where “target score required to unlock god” was displayed incorrectly on the R18+ god selection screen after the existing results window.
· We have resolved an issue where “Score” was incorrectly displayed as “Store” in the results window.

notes.title: Release Delay Notice
notes.notes:
Hello.
This is Cheese Burger Studio.

Our first work, "Body Pay," which was originally scheduled to be released today, was postponed to the next day, 04/19/2024 (PDT), due to a Steam error.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

From now on, I will greet you in a better way.
Tomorrow's launch is scheduled to take place between 2:30 and 4:30 PM PDT.
